WITNESSETH WHEREAS, Owner is the owner of the fee title to a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City and State of New York, known as and by (i) the street address 270 Fifth Street,Brooklyn,New York, and (i) the Tax Lot Number 11,Block 987 (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as “Lot A"or “Owner's Land", and more particularly described on Schedule “A” attached hereto and made a part hereof; said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof as permitted hereunder, being hereinafter referred to as the “Owner's Building"; and said land and buildings and improvements being hereinafter collectively referred to as the "Owner's Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner of the fee title to a certain parcel of land,with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City and State of New York, known as and by (i) the street address 267 Sixth Street, Brooklyn, New York (formerly known as 363 Fourth Avenue, Brooklyn, New York), and (i) the Tax Lot Number 1, Block 987 (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as “Lot B" or “Developer's Land", and more particularly described on Schedule “B” attached hereto and made a part hereof; said existing buildings and improvements, together with any alterations thereto built on Developer's Land, being hereinafter referred to as Developer's New Building, as herein defined, being hereinafter collectively referred to as the "Developer'sPremises"); Land, and to construct a new building on Developer's Land (hereinafter called the “Developer's New Building"); WHEREAS, it is contemplated that the Developer's New Building will contain more floor area than now is available for use on Developer's Land pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, and the parties hereto therefore desire to utilize the procedures available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution for combining Owner's Land and Developer's Land into a single zoning lotfor the purpose of making available the Excess Zoning Rights (hereinafter defined) for utilization in connection with the construction and maintenance of Developer's New Building, and Owner is willing to make such Excess Zoning Rights available to Developer in perpetuity; WHEREAS, Owner is willing to make the Excess Zoning Rights available toDeveloper; and 127461.00406/6627038v.2

WHEREAS, the parties hereto are simultaneously herewith executing a Declaration of Restrictions (the “Declaration") in accordance with certain provisions set forth in the definition of the term “zoning lot" in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution in order to create a single zoning lot (the “Combined Zoning Lot") from Owner's Land, Developer's Land and such other parcels as may be included therein. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing, and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto hereby agree as follows: 1. The following terms used herein shall have the meanings and definitions as hereinafter setforth: (a)_"Zoning Resolution" shall mean the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15, 1961, as amended from time to time. (b)“Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean the rights, determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, that are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop such zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined by (i) multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the basic maximum allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district in which the zoning lot is located; and (ii) the inclusion of any under the Zoning Resolution and that may be authorized to be developed by the NewYork City Planning Commission or other appropriate agency of the City of New York. (c)“"Reserved Development Rights" shall mean the actual Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant the Owner's Premises less the Excess Zoning Rights. (d) "Excess Zoning Rights" shall mean 13,500 square feet of Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant to the Owner's Premises. (e)References to “bulk", “floor area", “floor area ratio", “zoning lot", "commercial use", “residential use", and “party(ies) in interest” shall have the meanings ascribed to such terms in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution. 2. Prior to or simultaneously herewith, Developer has delivered to Owner a written certification of its architect (the “Architect's Certification") certifying that there exists at least Premises.  3. (a)  Owner hereby grants to Developer an affirmative right to construct and maintain windows on the eastern and southern perimeter of Developer's New Building abutting Owner's Premises ("Developer's Windows").Owner shall not take any action now or ever, or enlarge or extend Owner's Building as it exists on the date hereof, that might interfere with Developer's unqualified use of, the light and air to, and the enjoyment of Developer's Windows. However, the restriction contained in this Section 3(a) shall in no way effect Owner's ability to build up on the existing foot print of Owner's building. 2 127461.00406/6627038v.2
